description: Search the ISMS Directory catalog of ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, DORA, NIS 2 and other compliance service providers (consultants, auditors, platforms, training). Filters are exact tags; several frameworks are combined with AND. Use list_categories first if you are unsure of a tag. Results are sorted by name, not ranked. Same data as GET https://ismsdirectory.com/api/search.

frameworks.description: Framework tags, e.g. ['ISO 27001', 'DORA']. AND across values.

q.description: Natural-language query mapped to filters, e.g. 'ISO 27001 consultants in Germany with DORA'. Ignored for a dimension when that dimension's explicit filter is set.

name: search_services
title: Search compliance services
